en-US.author: Svante Seleborg
en-US.copyright: Copyright © 2022-2026 Svante Seleborg, All Rights Reserved
en-US.description: An easy to use free desktop zero-knowledge file encryption application.
en-US.longDescription: Xecrets Ez encrypts and decrypts files to protect your sensitive data with a password using strong AES-256 encryption. It is a cross platform GUI front for Xecrets Cli, available for Windows, macOS and Linux.
en-US.name: Xecrets Ez
en-US.releaseNotes:
Improve portability, reliability, and performance. Linux stability fixes, smoother licensing and error handling, Chinese language support and updated dependencies.
- Implement true portability [ez]
- Don't freeze on temporarily unavailable network recent files [ez]
- Replace the CliToolNotFound crash dump with an error dialog [ez,sdk,common]
- Improve handling of changes to destination directory status [ez,common]
- Detect link to license page instead of license key [ez,common]
- Detect when a license is on the clipboard and do auto paste [ez]
- Show the original file when re-encryption fails [ez]
- Optimize key derivation and increase rounds [net]
- Use GUID to identify encrypted files [net]
- Opt out from legacy content texts from Xecrets.Net.Content [net]
- Do encryption decryption on background threads [net]
- Optimize KeyWrap [net]
- Fix regression with restart not working [ez]
- Fix regressions triggered by Avalonia 12.1.2 upgrade on Linux [ez]
- Fix YubiKey listener CPU-issue and some IDisposable leaks [ez]
- Fix intermittent crash on exit on Linux [ez]
- Fix Clipboard crash on Linux [ez]
- Fix friendly message when a damaged file can't be decrypted [ez]
- Fix wrong warning count when encrypting many files [ez]
- Reduce review request nagging [ez]
- Fix task related bugs with automatic close [ez]
- Fix wrongful closing of streams [net]
- Avoid noisy warnings from the MSIX project on Linux and macOS [ez]
- Work around C# compiler warning bug in Rider [ez]
- Update sign and notarize script for macOS [ez]
- Add copy button to exception message box [ez]
- Update Freedesktop SDK runtime to 26.08 [ez]
- Update flathub screenshots [ez]
- Fix StartupWMClass in .desktop for Linux [ez]
- Clean up window sizing [ez]
- Add mobile to list of projects [ez]
- Convert solution to .slnx [ez,cli,sdk,common,localization,licensing,words,slip39,net]
- Move culture handling to Xecrets.Texts [ez]
- Rename xecrets-texts repository to xecrets-common [ez,common]
- Provide options for unrecognized remaining files [ez]
- Define configuration and settings in Xecrets.Common [ez,cli,sdk,common,net]
- Update annual BIS self classification [ez]
- Clean up texts naming and accelerator stripping [ez,common]
- Prevent the cli tool from being deleted while app is running [ez]
- Refactor file name extension methods [ez,sdk,common]
- Ignore wipe of already deleted files [cli]
- Display name of cli status code instead of numeric [sdk]
- Add support for test site URL mapping [common]
- Use quotes consistently and correctly [common]
- Simplified Chinese translation [common]
- Add label support for mobile apps [common]
- Add button texts for mobile apps [common]
- Lookup current culture on each use of a text [localization]
- Update Yubico.YubiKey to 1.18.0 [ez]
- Update Tmds.DBus.Protocol on Linux to 0.95.1 [ez]
- Update .NET SDK to 10.0.401 [ez,cli,sdk,common,localization,licensing,words,slip39,net]
- Update Avalonia to 12.1.2 [ez,cli,sdk]
- Update NuGet dependencies [ez,cli,sdk,common,localization,licensing,words,slip39,net]
- Update Xecrets.Licensing to 2.3.1668 [cli]
- Update ReactiveUI.Primitives to 8.1.0 [sdk]
- Update package dependencies [common,localization,net]
- Add README to Xecrets.Common [common]
- Add url to Xecrets Ez page [common]

zh-CN.description: 一款易于使用的免费桌面端零知识文件加密应用。
zh-CN.longDescription: Xecrets Ez 使用密码和强 AES-256 加密对文件进行加密与解密，以保护您的敏感数据。它是 Xecrets Cli 的跨平台图形界面前端，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。
